evidence: src/infrastructure/in-memory-order-repository.ts: class InMemoryOrderRepository implements OrderRepository, so it is a persistence adapter for a domain port
save() stores a copy of the order in a Map, which is a storage responsibility
getById()/getAll() return defensive copies from the Map, which is a retrieval responsibility
getByState() filters with order.state === state, which is a persistence query with no domain decision logic
parsedVerdict.reasoning: InMemoryOrderRepository is an infrastructure adapter that implements the domain OrderRepository port. Each of its methods (save, getById, getAll, getByState) handles only storage and retrieval in a Map, plus defensive copying of orders. getByState filters by a state value, which is a plain persistence query. It does not decide anything about valid state transitions. The file has no business rules, validation, pricing or workflow logic, and no transport or presentation work. All of its responsibilities fit the infrastructure layer.
